purpose: Content-addressed rebuttal precedent (owner-adopted 2026-11-04, v14-hold solution §2e). An entry links a finding fingerprint + cited path to the git blob the cited file had when the disposition was made. A later review classifies a matching finding as standing ONLY while the cited file's blob is unchanged; any edit to the file retires the precedent automatically and the finding is adjudicated fresh. Seeded with the five guard-minor dispositions sustained across review-v11..v14. Extended at v0.11.0 (2026-11-04) with the owner's sustained-refutation rulings: 10 of the 12 from review-v15 (the 2 CHANGELOG-cited claims, 3c39c4bdc15a and 2fa2b04e08d5, cannot be expressed — their cited lines held disposition text that has since moved in a living changelog, and function keying does not apply to Markdown; the rulings stand in the v15 report) and the 4 step4 protected-class rulings, function-keyed at HEAD where the cited code resolves.
